# Shruti 1.4.35
- A new version is easy to spot: "Update available — <version>" appears at the top of the Shruti panel, and the menu-bar icon gets an orange dot. Click it to choose Install or Later. Nothing installs on its own, and an update still waits while audio or recording is active. - Check for Updates… is in the panel's ··· menu (with the version you have beside it) and in Settings. - Shruti checks when it opens and then every hour (was every six hours). A scheduled check no longer opens an update window behind your other apps; the button and the dot do the asking.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later; Apple silicon and Intel. Existing settings, app arrangements and window preferences are retained.
